Line Producer - EA SPORTS™ FC Vancouver, Canada EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games. Building on an incredible 30 year foundation, we’re redefining football with EA SPORTS FC - a genre-leading ecosystem of interactive experiences, bringing a global community of football fans closer to The World's Game. Together, we’re taking the largest football club in the world to new heights – and this is just the beginning! With more opportunity than ever to innovate and create new, authentic experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and immersion to fans everywhere, we invite you to join us as we pioneer the future of football with EA SPORTS FC, and welcome everyone to the club! As a Line Producer in EA SPORTS FC, you will direct and lead a team responsible for delivering a pillar within the FC product. You will be responsible for constructing mode-level and ecosystem product strategy to achieve business goals in partnership with the Game Design Director. You will be responsible for directing execution of the strategy in partnership with the Lead Development Director and Technical Director. You will report directly to a Production Director. The sports genre continues to evolve with inspiration and influence from a range of other genres including large online multiplayer shooters, rpg games, open world games, co-op PvE games, user-generated gaming platforms, and narrative games. We invite you to join us if you have extensive experience in one or more of the above spaces and believe you can drive innovation in sports through cross-pollination of ideas. This is a hybrid remote/in-office role. Responsibilities: You will construct the vision and drive roadmaps for a game mode fantasy in alignment with the broader goals of EA SPORTS FC and EA. You will use insights from various sources to establish opportunities and goals, focusing ideation and spurring creativity across the game mode. You will partner with licensing, brand, legal, and other central teams to determine goals and end to end requirements that are critical to the execution success. You will partner with product management, art, design, and engineering leads to deliver on expectations. You will partner with the development directors to establish new and/or improve existing processes, enable the program schedule and milestones deliverables. You will establish the OKRs for your team that align with the organizational and franchise KRs. Qualifications: You are an experienced Producer or Product Manager with 10+ years of experience in game production roles, tenured with building products from creation to live services. You have a track record leading 30+ people teams. You have passion for pioneering, and encouraging others to consider different perspectives. You use data and insights to inform decision-making, planning and road mapping. You are a master of influence and an accomplished mediator and resolver of conflicts. You are able to navigate ambiguity and proactively transform unknowns into actionable solutions. You have AAA development experience in one or more of the following genres: large online multiplayer shooters, rpg games, open world games, co-op PvE games, user-generated gaming platforms, and narrative games. Bonus: you are a football (soccer) fan, or a sports fan in general. jobs.description: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. We're the team behind Amazon WorkSpaces - the cloud desktop platform that lets millions of users provision secure Windows, Amazon Linux, or Ubuntu desktops and access them from any device or browser without anyone having to procure hardware or wrestle with complex installs. Users scale up or down instantly as their organization changes. If you like working on problems where latency, security, reliability, and scale all collide at once, this is your kind of role. The End User Computing market is growing at an incredible pace right now, which means you'll be solving some of the most interesting problems in providing secure, fast, highly scalable streaming infrastructure - while working across industry-leading AWS services. Our team is innovating across multiple areas to deliver the best-in-class interactive streaming platform, and as an SDE you'll own features end-to-end, ship to real enterprise and ISV customers, and have a direct hand in shaping what world-class application streaming looks like next. We are looking for passionate SDEs who want to build their career in End User Computing. If this sounds interesting to you, talk to us! Key job responsibilities • As an SDE on the WorkSpaces team you'll design and build features for our cloud desktop and interactive streaming platform - end to end from scoping through production. You'll write clean, maintainable code that runs at scale, optimize real-time streaming paths for latency and reliability, and operate what you ship (including on-call). You'll work across multiple AWS services to deliver secure, highly available infrastructure that enterprise and ISV customers depend on daily. Expect to dive deep into performance - profiling, benchmarking, identifying bottlenecks - and collaborate with senior engineers on system design and architecture decisions. You'll participate in code reviews, raise the bar on engineering standards, and contribute to operational excellence across the team. When something's broken or could be better, you take initiative and fix it. You'll also help us figure out how to scale - both technically (millions of concurrent desktops) and as a team (mentoring, improving processes, writing useful documentation). The End User Computing space is evolving fast, so you'll frequently evaluate new approaches and help decide where we invest next to keep our streaming platform best-in-class. A day in the life On a typical day you'll balance executing on our long-term roadmap with responding to emerging customer issues and finding inventive ways to satisfy new customer needs. You'll work closely with engineers, product managers, and partner teams across AWS like networking and security. Your customers are enterprise IT organizations and ISV partners who need desktops that are reliable, secure, and fast - so the feedback loop is tight and the problems are real. Beyond regular engineering work, there's always room to stretch into areas like mentoring or shaping team direction. About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
